about: Placeholder substitution in one decrypted request head (docs/networking.md "Secrets"), read by the tests of both editions: Tests/GlovDaemonTests/SecretSubstitutionTests.swift and windows/internal/egress/substitution_test.go. Each case's head goes to host:port from VM vm with the secrets granted. A case expects a plan (the secrets it names, in order of first use, and the path without its query) or a refusal (status and egress.log reason; the message differs between editions, which name the host they run on). With values, the plan is applied and gives output, or applyRefusal.

cases.name: header values get their values, Basic credentials included, the query is left alone and the connection closes
cases.head:
POST /repo.git/git-upload-pack?x=glov-secret:gh HTTP/1.1
Host: API.example.com
Authorization: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46Z2xvdi1zZWNyZXQ6Z2g=
X-Token: glov-secret:gh.user glov-secret:gh
Connection: keep-alive
Proxy-Authorization: x
cases.output:
POST /repo.git/git-upload-pack?x=glov-secret:gh HTTP/1.1
Host: API.example.com
Authorization: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46VDE=
X-Token: U2 T1
Connection: close

cases.name: a longer name is never rewritten by a shorter one
cases.head:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
A: glov-secret:gh.user;glov-secret:gh
cases.output:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
A: long;short
Connection: close
